blocks.title: Marketing Performance Dashboard Templates
blocks.subtitle: Measure the impact of marketing on your business with a suite of ready-to-use free dashboard templates built in Tableau

items.title: Marketing Overview
items.body: Get insights into Key Performance, Efficiency and Awareness metrics trends across all Marketing platforms. Highlight successes and areas of improvement from an overall marketing perspective.

items.title: Campaign Overview
items.body: Understand what factors impact Customer Value over time, and the purchasing gap between customers’ first and last purchase

items.title: Shopify Overview
items.body: Get insights into the performance of your Shopify store in a glance. Understand acquisition channels & trends along with key metrics like CLTV, CAC, AOV and many more.

items.title: Marketplace Overview
items.body: Get a snapshot of revenue trends across e-Commerce marketplaces across key categories, products & brands.

items.title: Product & Category Breakdown
items.body: Analyze your customers’ journeys through the lens of products (SKU) or major and minor Product categories in your D2C store

items.title: Cohorts By Acquisition Month
items.body: Understand the impact and trends of your important KPIs like Lifetime Value (LTV) across time

items.title: Cohorts By Acquisition Product
items.body: Analyze the first touchpoint of their customers through the lens of Products. Identify popular products among first-time and repeat customers and products that require more attention.

items.title: Cohorts By Acquisition Location
items.body: Analyze the first touchpoint of their customers through the lens of Geography. Identify the places with higher first-time and repeat customers and, hence, could be targeted more
